add_sources.note: Official Snow Peak Way 2026 event page.

2026 schedule: 12 weekends from 4 to 5 Apr (HQ) to 26 to 27 Sep (Akagi, Gunma). Notice of 2 Sep 2026: Snow Peak Way 2026 in Okuhita (5 to 6 Sep) cancelled for safety due to Typhoon No. 26. Record had Okuhita as held.

2026 venues include Snow Peak HQ Campfield (Niigata), Minoh (Osaka), Rikuzentakata (Iwate), Ochi (Kochi), Narita Yume Bokujo (Chiba), Makino Kogen (Shiga), Kanuma (Tochigi), Ookidani (Hiroshima), Tokachi Poroshiri (Hokkaido), Okuhita (Oita), Akagi (Gunma).

Sponsor section 2026: Suntory Tennensui, Hakushu, ROKU, ALL-FREE, Starbucks Coffee Japan, Kuze Fuku & Co., Asahi Shuzo, BRING (clothing and tent recycling), Canon Marketing Japan. Program credits: cafe by Nestlé Japan, morning soup by Kuze Fuku, bonfire talk drinks by Suntory and Asahi Shuzo.
Sponsors supply program content: Nestlé cafe, Kuze Fuku morning soup, Suntory All-Free and whisky/gin at the bonfire talk; BRING runs a gear and clothing recycling collection.
Google snippet (blog): Snow Peak Way 'about 5,000 participants each time'.
Google snippet (column): about 5,000 at Snow Peak Way and reportedly 8,000 at each Seppo-sai.
Google snippet: first 2026 Snow Peak Way at HQ, Sanjo, with over 200 user groups.
Event page lists an event enquiry form, the general support form (support.snowpeak.co.jp) and phone 0120-010-660. No partnership or sponsorship contact published.

notes: Correction: the Okuhita weekend (5 to 6 Sep 2026) was cancelled for a typhoon; the last 2026 weekend held was Akagi, 26 to 27 Sep.
